mapper.select:
/*selectCommonCoCoCatalogAlterList*/ SELECT A.BUYER_ITEM_NO AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = C.AGENT) AS AGENT_NAME, C.MAKER_NAME AS MAKER_NAME, C.UNIT_PRICE AS UNIT_PRICE, C.LIST_PRICE AS LIST_PRICE, C.UNIT_MEASURE AS UNIT_MEASURE, DECODE(C.BELOW_COMORG_CODE,'ABOVE','공통/나머지', (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = C.BELOW_COMORG_CODE)) AS BELOW_TEXT,
DECODE(A.STATUS,'D','삭제',DECODE(C.STATUS,'D','삭제', DECODE(A.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG,'N','승인','Y','단종','A','일회용_미발주','C','일회용_기발주','B','BLOCKED' ))) AS STATUS_TEXT,
DECODE(A.STATUS,'D','삭제',DECODE(C.STATUS,'D','삭제', DECODE(A.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG,'N','승인','Y','단종','A','일회용_미발주','C','신규요청품목'))) AS STATUS_TEXT,
DECODE(A.STATUS,'D','삭제',DECODE(C.STATUS,'D','삭제', DECODE(A.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG,'N','승인','Y','단종'))) AS STATUS_TEXT,
DECODE(NVL(DECODE(SUBSTR(A.STDCATLG_ID,0,1),'M',A.STDCATLG_ID,''),'00'),'00','NO','YES') AS MAPP_TEXT, C.DESCRIPTION AS DESCRIPTION, A.SPECIFICATION AS SPECIFICATION, A.BUYER AS BUYER, A.STATUS AS BYIT_STATUS, A.CMS_CATLG_ID AS STDCATLG_ID, A.CMS_CATEG_ID AS STDCATEG_ID, A.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG AS PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG, C.BELOW_COMORG_CODE AS BELOW_COMORG_CODE, C.STATUS AS CQDT_STATUS, C.CONTRACT_NO AS CONTRACT_NO, C.CONTRACT_SEQ AS CONTRACT_SEQ, C.AGENT AS AGENT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ICOMCQEP P WHERE P.BUYER = C.BUYER AND P.BUYER_ITEM_NO = C.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND P.CONTRACT_NO = C.CONTRACT_NO AND P.CONTRACT_SEQ = C.CONTRACT_SEQ) AS CQEP_CNT, C.CHANGE_DATE AS CHANGE_DATE FROM ICOMBYIT A, ICOMBYCA B, ICOMCQDT C, ICOMBYCA D WHERE A.BUYER = #{st_buyer_code} AND A.PURCHASING_AGENT_FLAG = 'Y' AND A.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG NOT IN ('S','G') AND A.BUYER = B.COM_CODE AND A.CATEGORY_NO = B.STD_CATEG_ID AND B.COM_CODE = D.COM_CODE AND A.BUYER = C.BUYER AND A.BUYER_ITEM_NO = C.BUYER_ITEM_NO
AND D.STD_CATEG_ID =#{st_categ_id} AND B.CATEG_SYS_CODE LIKE D.CATEG_SYS_CODE||'%'
AND B.STD_CATEG_ID = D.STD_CATEG_ID
AND A.BUYER_ITEM_NO LIKE #{st_buyer_item_no}||'%'
AND (C.AGENT = #{st_agent_code} OR C.ORIGIN_AGENT = #{st_agent_code})
AND A.STATUS != 'D' AND C.STATUS != 'D' AND A.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG = 'N'
AND A.STATUS != 'D' AND A.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG = 'Y'
AND A.STATUS != 'D' AND A.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG = 'A'
AND A.STATUS != 'D' AND A.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG = 'C'
AND A.STATUS != 'D' AND A.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG = 'B'
AND (A.STATUS = 'D' OR C.STATUS = 'D')
AND C.ADD_DATE BETWEEN #{st_from_date} AND #{st_to_date}
AND C.CHANGE_DATE BETWEEN #{st_from_date} AND #{st_to_date}
AND C.DESCRIPTION LIKE UPPER('%'||#{resultInDescription}||'%')
AND C.SPECIFICATION LIKE UPPER('%'||#{resultInSpecification}||'%')
AND C.MAKER_NAME LIKE UPPER('%'||#{resultInMaker}||'%')
ORDER BY CHANGE_DATE DESC
